title: Accurate Inventory
description: My first small resource pack that aims to make the symbols of the layer inventory more accurate
body:
This resource pack updates Minecraft’s inventory icons to make them more intuitive and visually accurate. Instead of abstract or placeholder-style symbols, the icons now better reflect the items they represent.

**Current features**
- Shield slot icon replaced with a Totem of Undying symbol

- Armor slot icons redesigned to resemble actual armor pieces rather than a generic body outline

More improvements and refinements will be added in future updates.
